description: Entering final `S.Done` queues `S`'s completion, but `S`'s `always` is taken first, and it goes back to `S.Work` without leaving `S`: exiting `Done` takes the completion back, so `S`'s `done` is not taken while `S` is in `Work`. The second time `Work` ends no `always` is enabled, and the completion leaves `S`.
